title: A DOC fact a change adds without an anchor quote is caught at that change's landing, not left to a later item
goal: The landing's lint step fails the change that adds a DOC fact whose source has no anchor with a quote, naming the fact, so the anchor row lands in the same item; and texts-catalogue-formats.md's FluentLocalization fact (S1710) gets its anchor. In SP-lsamtvsz the research commit ffc605f25 added that fact with only a lint warning; the next item that touched the line (BG-nzrj2n32) saw the warning but _anchors.csv was outside its touches.
notes: SP-lsamtvsz retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator. Plan amendment 2026-10-15: its anchor clause (texts-catalogue-formats.md's FluentLocalization fact, S1710) is covered by ST-ez6r5em7 in SP-z3jcdsgr, widened to factdiff.py --root public anchors --stale = 0; once that lands the clause is met and only the lint-at-landing clause stays open (it names a new test id: retarget it to an existing test before it is planned).
